service.description: The people to share a mail account with, mention or message: active user accounts whose name or username has the term, as {id (the userId), value (the same), label}. Leaves out disabled accounts and the system's own (an agent's or another account whose username starts with _). Any signed-in user may look people up by name, as in a mail client's address book, but only the people they may reach (SEC-COM-01): no external user (EXTERNAL_USER) is found by anyone, an external caller finds only the people of their own rooms, and a user an app's chat-target provider refuses (call-target for purpose call, the Calls pickers) is left out, as one that does not exist (org.moqui.chat.ChatServices get#RefusedUsers).

parameter.name: purpose
parameter.description: chat (find, message, share) or call (the provider hook asked is then call-target).
